description: Planning estimate of import duty, entry fees and typical customs clearance time for a shipment crossing a border. For U.S. imports it looks the goods up in the official Harmonized Tariff Schedule by HS/HTS code or product words and returns matching tariff lines with their general duty rate, plus the Merchandise Processing Fee and (ocean only) the Harbor Maintenance Fee. For other destinations it returns only a country-wide average tariff. It does NOT calculate origin-dependent extra U.S. tariffs (Section 232, Section 301, country-specific tariffs) or import VAT/GST, and it is not customs advice or a classification ruling: always pass the disclaimer and notes on to the user. If several tariff lines come back, ask the user which describes their goods, then call again with that line's code.

cargo_value_usd.description: Customs value of the goods in U.S. dollars, or null to get rates without amounts.

dest_country.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Example: 'US'.

hs_code.description: U.S. imports: HS or HTS code, at least 4 digits, e.g. '6109.10.00'. Null when unknown.

mode.description: How the goods arrive; the U.S. harbor fee applies to ocean only. Null defaults to ocean.

origin_country.description: Origin country, ISO alpha-2 code, or null if unknown. Example: 'CN'.

product.description: U.S. imports, when no code is known: a few plain product words, e.g. 'cotton t-shirts'. Null otherwise.

name: estimate_duties
title: Estimate import duties, fees and customs time
